scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:42869/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.objective: Read the recall brief and each explanation's dossier plus its linked independent lab report, then determine which explanation the lab evidence supports, cite the supporting measurement, and explain what ruled out the other two.
args.headline: Weigh three recall explanations against lab evidence

args.observation: The bearing seat machining lab report supports that theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize.
args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: The ceramic coating cure lab report rules out that theory: coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.observation: The packaging compression lab report rules out that theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.subject: Bearing seat machining is the supported explanation for the Q3 fixture widget recall
args.detail: Lab found bearing seats 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch; coating cure and packaging theories ruled out by in-tolerance/spec measurements.

metrics.answerText:
**Supported: bearing seat machining.** Each dossier at the recall brief links its independent lab report; all three were read.

| Theory | Lab report finding | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| [Bearing seat machining](http://127.0.0.1:42869/theory-bearing) | [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:46609/lab-bearing): "Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined **0.4 mm undersize**." | **SUPPORTED** |
| [Ceramic coating cure](http://127.0.0.1:42869/theory-coating) | [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:46609/lab-coating): "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch." | Not supported |
| [Packaging compression](http://127.0.0.1:42869/theory-packaging) | [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:46609/lab-packaging): "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch." | Not supported |

**The measurement it rests on:** 0.4 mm undersize bearing seats, present on every recalled batch.

**Ruled out:**
- *Ceramic coating cure* — cure times measured within tolerance on every recalled batch, so over-fast curing is not the cause.
- *Packaging compression* — packaging matched spec on every recalled batch, so transit compression from undersized packaging is not the cause.
